messages:
Alex: quick midday handoff — wrapping my shift. Key changes: deployed canary v2.3.1 to eu-west canary pool at 11:05 UTC (no errors so far). Prefetch queue spike ~11:20 UTC — peaked ~2.1k queued requests; autoscale responded but tail latency bumped ~120ms. Dedupe-worker showing intermittent timeouts (see logs below). Scheduled infra maintenance tonight 03:00-03:30 UTC for networking patches — expect brief packet drops; please avoid deploys during window. Action items: @Kevin please pick up canary validation in the AM, @Maria please dig into dedupe-job logs and file a ticket if recurring, @Sam confirm on-prem metrics scraping is green. I muted non-critical alerts for the spike. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Maria: looking now — grabbing logs. I see repeated `context deadline exceeded` in dedupe-worker around 11:18. Quick check: ``kubectl logs -l app=dedupe -n infra | grep 'context deadline exceeded' | wc -l`` -> 14. Tailing for 20m and will paste any stack traces.

Sam: on-prem metrics look green from here, no scrape errors in the last hour. VPC peering latency stable. If the network patch causes a hiccup we'll see short gaps in scraping; I'll add a short note to runbook.

Kevin: I can validate the canary tomorrow 06:30 UTC. Plan: run regen-samples + smoke tests against v2.3.1, check latency percentiles and error rates for 15m window. If regression, we'll auto-fallback to v2.3.0.

OncallBot: rotation update — Alex handed off to Kevin at 12:01 UTC. Reminder: oncall rotation window 06:00-18:00 UTC.

Alex: small addendum — avoid deploys to eu-west between 02:30-04:00 UTC. Also watch prefetch thresholds (currently 800 tokens); if queues trend up over next 24h we should consider a temporary bump.

Sam: added runbook entry: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefetch-spike with steps to flush prefixes, scale prefetch service, and rollback.

Maria: opened ticket INF-4782 with log excerpts and initial triage, tagged eng-runtime and infra. Will try to reproduce under a 2k qps load in staging today.

Kevin: acked. I'll run the checks in the morning and report back in this thread with pass/fail + metrics snapshot. :eyes:
